title: Steady Your Nerves
coreMove: Slow the first bodily surge enough that panic cannot turn a hard signal into a total emergency.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Perception, so it must teach cleaner seeing before it teaches action or endurance. Source sidecar ch02 exists and provides partial-source support only; no full text is frozen. For "Steady Your Nerves", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Slow the first bodily surge enough that panic cannot turn a hard signal into a total emergency.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into generic mindset advice instead of a precise discipline of reading the obstacle cleanly. For "Steady Your Nerves", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.
